meta.name: linkerd-patterns
meta.description: Implement Linkerd service mesh patterns for lightweight, security-focused service mesh deployments. Use when setting up Linkerd, configuring traffic policies, or implementing zero-trust networking with minimal overhead.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是负责微服务基础设施、需要低开销安全通信的开发者
copy.tagline_en: Deploy a lightweight service mesh for zero-trust communication
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage microservices and need lightweight, secure service-to-service communication

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按 Linkerd 模板产出服务网格配置:安装与校验命令、命名空间自动注入、ServiceProfile 路由重试与超时、TrafficSplit 灰度分流、ServerAuthorization 访问控制,以及 viz 监控和排查命令。
howto.when: 当你要搭建 Linkerd 服务网格、配置流量策略(如重试、超时、灰度分流)或做零信任网络时会触发。

say.text: 帮我给 my-app 命名空间开启 Linkerd 自动注入
say.note: 生成带注入注解的 YAML

say.text: 给 my-service 写一个带重试预算和超时的 ServiceProfile
say.note: 含 retryBudget 与每路由 timeout

say.text: 配一个 90/10 的 TrafficSplit 灰度发布

howto.what_en: Claude writes Linkerd mesh config: install and check commands, namespace auto-injection, ServiceProfiles with retries and timeouts, TrafficSplit canaries, ServerAuthorization policies, and viz monitoring commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up Linkerd, configure traffic policies such as retries, timeouts or canary splits, or implement zero-trust networking with minimal overhead.

say_en.text: Enable Linkerd auto-injection for the my-app namespace
Write a ServiceProfile for my-service with retries and timeouts
Set up a 90/10 TrafficSplit canary for my-service
